name: webapp-harness
description: Install and operate a deterministic sequential web-application development harness with evidence-backed backlog generation.

interface.shortDescription: Generate backlogs and run verified development cycles.
interface.longDescription: Install a repository-native harness, audit evidence-backed gaps into a user-confirmed backlog, then run one deterministic implementation, verification, browser-validation, review, and commit cycle at a time.
defaultPrompt: Initialize the development harness and preview its first evidence-backed backlog.
Audit this repository for gaps and propose backlog tasks for my confirmation.
Run exactly one verified development cycle.
